googleWorkspace.setupTitle: How to set up the service account
googleWorkspace.setupStep1: Open Google Cloud Console → create or select a project → enable the "Enterprise License Manager API".
googleWorkspace.setupStep2: IAM & Admin → Service Accounts → create a new service account → Keys → Add Key → JSON, then download the file.
googleWorkspace.setupStep3: Copy the service account's numeric Client ID — in Google Admin Console → Security → API controls → Domain-wide delegation → Add new, paste the Client ID with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.licensing.
googleWorkspace.setupStep4: Paste the downloaded JSON file content above, and enter the email address of a Workspace admin to impersonate.
googleWorkspace.setupStep5: Add the product/SKU pairs you want to track below and click Save.
googleWorkspace.skuReferenceHint: You can find productId/skuId reference values in Google's Enterprise License Manager API documentation.

dropbox.title: Dropbox — configuration
dropbox.description: Connect InfraPilot to Dropbox Business using a scoped app with offline access (refresh token).
dropbox.appSecretKeep: App Secret (leave blank to keep unchanged)
dropbox.refreshTokenKeep: Refresh Token (leave blank to keep unchanged)
dropbox.setupTitle: How to obtain a refresh token
dropbox.setupStep1: Open the Dropbox App Console → Create app → Scoped access → Team (or Full Dropbox if Team isn't available) → note the App Key and App Secret.
dropbox.setupStep2: In the app's Permissions tab, enable the members.read and team_info.read scopes, then click Submit.
dropbox.setupStep3: Visit https://www.dropbox.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=YOUR_APP_KEY&response_type=code&token_access_type=offline, sign in as a team admin, approve access, and copy the authorization code shown on the page.
dropbox.setupStep4: Exchange the code for a refresh token: curl https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token -d code=YOUR_CODE -d grant_type=authorization_code -d client_id=YOUR_APP_KEY -d client_secret=YOUR_APP_SECRET — copy the refresh_token field from the response.
dropbox.setupStep5: Paste the App Key, App Secret and refresh token here and click Save.
dropbox.setupHint: This is a one-time step — the refresh token doesn't expire unless revoked, so InfraPilot can keep syncing without repeating this flow.
adobe.title: Adobe — configuration
adobe.description: Connect InfraPilot to Adobe using an OAuth Server-to-Server credential with access to the User Management API.
adobe.clientSecretKeep: Client Secret (leave blank to keep unchanged)
adobe.profilesDescription: Adobe doesn't expose a list of purchased plans — add the Product Profile names (as shown in Adobe Admin Console) you want to track manually.
adobe.setupTitle: How to set up the OAuth Server-to-Server credential
adobe.setupStep1: Open the Adobe Developer Console → Create a new project → Add API → User Management API → choose OAuth Server-to-Server.
adobe.setupStep2: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the credential's overview page.
adobe.setupStep3: Find your Org ID on the same page (format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX@AdobeOrg).
adobe.setupStep4: In Adobe Admin Console → Products, note the exact name of each Product Profile you want to track and add it below.
adobe.setupHint: Only named-user licenses under an Enterprise/Team agreement are supported this way — perpetual or individual Creative Cloud plans aren't manageable through this API.
